 MCX Q2 profit jumps over two-fold to ₹455 crore as trading volumes surge
 The exchange recorded a sharp increase in income and trading activity, with futures and options turnover rising during the September quarter.
 By PTI 
 Updated - November 04, 2026 at 09:27 AM. 
 | 
 New Delhi
 × Share
 WhatsApp X Facebook LinkedIn Messenger Reddit Mail https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/commodities/mcx-q2-profit-jumps-over-two-fold-to-455-crore-as-trading-volumes-surge/article71663889.ece Copy 
  Praveena Rai, MD and CEO, MCX
 Multi Commodity Exchange of India (MCX) has reported a more than two-fold jump in consolidated net profit to Rs 455 crore for the September quarter of FY27, driven by a sharp rise in income and trading volumes.
 The bourse had posted a net profit of Rs 197.47 crore in the year-ago period, according to a regulatory filing.
 Total income surged to Rs 799.66 crore from Rs 374.23 crore a year earlier. Expenses rose to Rs 211.36 crore from Rs 150.41 crore.
 On the volume front, the Average Daily Turnover (ADT) of futures climbed to Rs 62,819 crore during the quarter, while that of options rose to Rs 12,00,129 crore.
 The exchange also saw physical deliveries of 5.68 tonnes of gold, 199.91 tonnes of silver and 34,707 tonnes of base metals during the quarter.
 "Our strong performance in Q2 FY27 reflects the continued trust of market participants and the growing relevance of the exchange in the evolving commodity ecosystem," said Praveena Rai, MD and CEO, MCX.
 She attributed the performance to sustained growth across product segments, higher market participation and continued efforts to widen the product basket.
 "As we look ahead, our focus is on building on this strong foundation by continuing to broaden market participation, expand product portfolio, and invest in technology and innovation," Rai added.
